writingDashboard.title: Writing dashboard
writingDashboard.intro: Your creative rhythm, recorded as net Chinese characters between manuscript saves.
writingDashboard.privacy: Computed locally for this project. Records and journals are never added to AI context or uploaded.
writingDashboard.emptyTitle: Your next save starts the story of your progress
writingDashboard.emptyHelp: Write a little manuscript text and save it to create a real record. Deletions count, too.
writingDashboard.baselineHelp: Existing text is only the current manuscript baseline. Daily history before tracking began is never invented.
writingDashboard.heatmapHelp: The last 365 days. Deeper colors mean larger net gains. Hatching and a minus sign mark negative days. Select a date to read its journal.
writingDashboard.heatmapKeyboard: Daily net gain calendar. Use arrow keys to move, Home or End to jump, and Enter to select a date.
writingDashboard.noDailyNote: No journal entry for this day yet.
writingDashboard.daySaves: {{count}} manuscript save records. Writing time is not estimated.
writingDashboard.streakHelp: Only days with positive net gain count. Before a positive gain today, a streak may extend through yesterday; a negative day breaks it. Historical records use recorded manuscript saves.
writingDashboard.hourlyTitle: When do your saves add up?
writingDashboard.hourlyHelp: All records grouped by the hour of each manuscript save (UTC+8). This is net gain at save time, never time spent writing.
writingDashboard.sourceTitle: Manual and AI accepted, kept separate
writingDashboard.sourceHelp: Attribution across all recorded manuscript saves. Manual saves may include pasted text and do not prove authorship.
writingDashboard.sourceShareLabel: Share of positive additions: manual {{manual}}%, AI accepted {{ai}}%.
writingDashboard.noAttributableAdditions: No positive manual or AI accepted additions available for a share chart yet.
writingDashboard.sourceRatioHelp: Shares use only positive net-save additions from manual and AI accepted events. Deletions, restores and unknown sources are excluded from the ratio and shown separately. This is not a share of personally authored text.
writingDashboard.paceTitle: At this pace, when might you arrive?
writingDashboard.paceForecastHelp: Average net gain over 7 calendar days: {{average}} characters/day. With {{remaining}} characters remaining, this pace suggests about {{days}} days.
writingDashboard.paceMethod: The net gain over 7 calendar days, including today and zero-gain days, divided by 7. A reference only, not a promised completion date.
writingDashboard.noPaceHelp: Average net gain over the last 7 days is zero or negative, so no finish date is predicted.
writingDashboard.paceOutOfRange: The projected date is outside the supported range; no date is displayed.
writingDashboard.setBookTargetHelp: Set a target below to estimate from your actual net-gain records.
writingDashboard.targetCompleteHelp: Your current manuscript has reached the target. You are free to keep writing.
writingDashboard.goalsHelp: Daily and weekly goals use net gains. Volume and book goals use current manuscript Chinese characters. All goals are optional.
writingDashboard.goalOptional: Optional. Write freely without a target.
writingDashboard.chapterSummary: {{completed}} completed chapters · {{unfinished}} unfinished · {{characters}} current text characters including punctuation
writingDashboard.dailyNoteHelp: Leave a line about your day. Select a heatmap cell or change the date below. Journal entries stay local to this project.
writingDashboard.logBreakdown: Net {{net}} characters · Manual {{manual}} · AI accepted {{ai}} · Restored {{restore}} · Unknown {{unknown}}
writingDashboard.method: An honest count: net Chinese-character changes between manuscript saves only. Deletions are negative; repeat saves add zero. Manual, AI accepted, restored and unknown sources stay separate. Candidate generation and initial copies do not count; later edits to revision manuscripts count only their saved difference. Revision copies are not duplicated in the current book total.
writingDashboard.timezone: Dates, Monday-based calendar weeks and hours consistently use UTC+8. History before tracking began is not invented. External file-scan estimates are not counted as writing saves.
writingDashboard.excludedEstimates: {{count}} external file observation records are excluded from writing statistics.
writingDashboard.excludedInvalid: {{count}} unverifiable older records were skipped rather than counted as writing data.
writingDashboard.goalsUpToDate: Goal inputs match the saved settings.
writingDashboard.noteUnsaved: This day’s note has unsaved changes.
writingDashboard.noteUpToDate: This day’s note has no unsaved changes.
writingDashboard.pendingNoteCount_one: {{count}} date has a journal draft to save. Select the date to continue.
writingDashboard.pendingNoteCount_other: {{count}} dates have journal drafts to save. Select a date to continue.
writingDashboard.earlierSubmissionSaved: The previous submission was saved; newer input is still unsaved.
writingDashboard.noteSavedForDate: The journal entry for {{date}} was saved.
writingDashboard.notePreviewUnsaved: This preview shows your current unsaved journal draft.
writingDashboard.formSaveShortcut: Ctrl+S or Ctrl+Enter saves this form. Plain Enter still adds a line.

miniDashboardHelp: Net manuscript-save gains (UTC+8). Open the writing dashboard.
shelfTodayHelp: Today’s net Chinese-character difference on manuscript saves. Deletions are negative; manual and AI accepted attribution is available in the writing dashboard.
dailyGoalReached: Today’s net gain reached {{goal}} Chinese characters. Keep writing at your own pace.
